name: Attempt payment without securing trip or acknowledging terms

steps.name: When User closes the initial login popup
And User navigates to the Hotels section
When User proceeds to the booking page for the first available hotel
And User enters guest details using data from "guest_date.csv" on the booking page
And User explicitly unchecks or skips the "Yes, secure my trip" or mandatory acknowledgment checkboxes
And User clicks on the Pay Now button
Then A prompt should appear asking the user to confirm their trip security choice
And User should not be navigated to the payment gateway until resolved
